scope: Final held-out evaluation of the nine frozen E0/E2/E3 runs on all five reserved dataset-0.3 splits. Reported as measured; nothing was tuned on these results.
notes: Selected-object ADE/FDE and coverage are undefined for every method: no scene group has all its cases complete. Missing values stay missing.

Force-OOD has no zero-force condition and was prepared without the action plan; its reversal is scored by the horizon scorer. Its full-clip horizon is not scored because every group reaches contact first.
